title: 能力市场：设计师能否给出有记忆点、可选择的设计方向（v3 六态矩阵为基线）
task: stage: designer. Design the capability-market shelf and the asset detail drawer for this change (inputs: briefing with the operator's reference images described, compete notes, spec). Run task explore; the human delegates the pick, so continue with your recommended direction and run task specify.
v3_gaps_observed: grep on baseline edge-states.md (2026-09-17): prototype/原型 0 · .png 0 · 签名 0 matches
The baseline is a 41 KB state matrix plus IA; the operator's reference images are transcribed (参考图 ×5) but no alternative directions are explored or rendered
what_good_looks_like: Three or more structurally different directions that were actually rendered and looked at, each with a concrete signature moment tied to what makes the market valuable; a recommendation argued from users and the core path (not from resemblance to the reference images or a generic AI look) whose own screenshots are free of rendering defects; then a precise contract (flows, states with real copy, tokens) for it.

rubric.criterion: Explores at least three structurally different directions (layout and interaction model, not palette swaps), informed by references beyond the operator's images, each rendered and looked at, with trade-offs
Names a concrete, precisely specified signature moment tied to the core value
The recommended direction's own screenshots are free of rendering defects (overlap, clipping, broken layout, unreadable text, placeholder junk) at the stated viewports

Avoids generic AI-default styling (purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, emoji icons, interchangeable SaaS card grids) or justifies it; the recommendation argues from users and the core path, not from resemblance to the reference images
The design makes the core path (browse → understand → subscribe/enable) fast and obvious
The chosen direction is specified precisely: flows, all states with real copy, tokens
